Theme

Latin word

fīnis

fīnis, fīnis m.

noun, third declension

boundary, frontier; in the plural, territory; end; limit; a boundary, a limit; (plural) territory; the end a thing serves, its purpose; the end aimed at, a goal

In this lexicon

  • border

    also used · classical · Traupman 202, 204; Traupman 319

  • end

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 1.5.104: Brundisium longae fīnis chartaeque viaeque est; Gell. 7.13.3: edundī fīnis; Traupman 203; Traupman 309

  • limit

    also used · classical · Hor. S. 1.1.106: sunt certī dēnique fīnēs

  • purpose

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.138: domum … cujus fīnis est ūsus; Quint. 2.17.22: omnēs artēs habēre fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

  • target

    also used · classical · Quint. 2.17.22: fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

  • fīnis hebdomadis: weekend

    modern
